description.narrative: The Fund is expected to increase access to private equity (PE) capital and value-creation for small to mid-market companies in Türkiye. The persistent devaluation of the Turkish Lira against the US Dollar over the past decade has led to a decline in private equity investments in the country. Templeton Turkey II will provide equity financing and create value to portfolio companies through business development, operational improvement, fundraising, and M&A efforts, also leveraging the parent company's network and expertise. A meaningful share will also be invested in women owned or led businesses. Beyond the project, IFC expects that the successful raising of this fund will help signal market recovery and encourage the re-engagement of fund managers and institutional investors in the country.

The proposed transaction is an equity investment of up to US$ 25 million to Templeton Turkey Fund II SCSp. (Templeton Turkey II or the Fund), a closed-end private equity fund targeting small and mid-market companies in Türkiye. The Fund will be domiciled in Luxembourg.
